questions.q: What was the Theranos machine called?

questions.why: Lesson 1 mentions a $9 billion product valuation.

questions.q: What did Holmes claim the device could do?
a: Run 800 tests with a single drop of blood

questions.q: What was the only test the machine could actually perform?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says it could only do an immunoassay.

questions.q: How did Theranos avoid FDA scrutiny, per lesson 3?
a: It pretended the Edison wasn't a medical device by sending samples to a lab
questions.why: Lesson 3 says they sent results to Siemens's lab to claim it wasn't a device.
